market: Global Drone Surveying & LiDAR Mapping Market
market_definition: Global Drone Surveying & LiDAR Mapping Market. Product / technology: Drone type: rotary-wing, fixed-wing, hybrid VTOL, specialized UAV; sensor: LiDAR, photogrammetry, RGB, thermal, multispectral; positioning: GNSS/RTK, PPK, IMU; software: mission planning, point-cloud processing, 3D modeling, GIS/CAD deliverables. Business models: Hardware sale, drone-as-a-service, LiDAR-as-a-service, data-processing-as-a-service, turnkey survey project, managed survey program. Applications: Topographic mapping, corridor mapping, construction monitoring, volumetrics, mining survey, forestry, coastal/bathymetric survey, utility corridor mapping. End users: Surveying and geospatial firms, construction and infrastructure, mining, oil and gas, utilities, agriculture and forestry, government and public agencies. Geography: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Middle East & Africa; India as a focus country.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR / CHANNEL PARTNER DEFINITION (hardware + software market): this market sells both hardware and software, so two shapes qualify - a stocking or authorized DISTRIBUTOR buying hardware in volume and reselling it, and a CHANNEL PARTNER, value-added reseller or SYSTEM INTEGRATOR that resells, bundles or implements another vendor's platform, software or modules. EXCLUDED: manufacturers, OEMs and their sales subsidiaries; vendors selling their own platform; consultancies with nothing to resell; and consumer-only retailers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
